asks: How does each agent program take a reply that Silo changed?
answer: To find out, by a live check per program, before denied tool calls are offered for that program. The check denies one call of each tool a rule can name. It shows that the program runs nothing of the denied call, takes the reply without an error or a retry, and goes on working afterwards. It shows that the model sees its own call and the error on the next request, also when the conversation is resumed later. Denied tool calls are offered for a program only once it passes. The check runs again for each new version a recipe pins. On a version that has not passed, a rule still denies the call at the boundary, and the app says that the program may not take the denial cleanly.
